decision.summary: Two transient offset candidates in N/E/U during 365–415: (1) 365–375: multi-sample drop in N with correlated E/U offsets, no clear return; (2) 410–415: sharp N drop with partial rebound and correlated E/U transients, but no confirmed opposing return within allowed context [365,579]. Both lack unambiguous return signatures; status remains uncertain. No other temporary offsets confirmed in allowed context.
